title: Honey's templates are generic and coach what to write; the Free Human Movement Space keeps its own words

source.ref: Daniel 2026-11-18: "Make every Frequency theme FULLY generic with copy that coaches them what to write. Be sure anybody using a theme keeps their content but give the templates a full scrub."

detail: The Honey theme (code id free-human) was built from one owner's design, so its template defaults named her (Audrey Uma Wilder), her two books and her program, and every Honey site's header carried an 'Audrey' mega menu and her footer letter line. lib/sites/free-human-home.ts is now the theme's generic template: each section says what to write there (hero, program parts, lyric line, workshops, gatherings, books, speaking, roots), in the design's shape and photos (Frequency's own plus the honey-light shots). The header menus are generic (Program, Gather, Read, About) and the footer letter has no name. The Free Human Movement Space keeps everything it saved; its own words move to lib/sites/free-human-movement-home.ts (its seed only), and its header menus, wordmark line and letter stay its own (isFreeHumanMovement in lib/sites/free-human-chrome.ts). Block render never reads the template, so no saved page changes.
